# Brick Wheels

> > Traverse City's premier bike shop and ski store offering Trek, Cannondale, Surly, and Electra bikes with rentals, expert guides, and full-service maintenance.

Brick Wheels serves Northern Michigan cyclists and skiers with new bike sales, electric bikes, bike rentals, ski rentals, and comprehensive buying guides. The shop specializes in road, gravel, mountain, and electric bikes from major brands including Trek, Cannondale, Ibis, and Electra, plus components from DT Swiss, Bontrager, and Park Tool.

## Key Topics

- Trek bikes
- Cannondale bikes
- Electric bikes (e-bikes)
- Bike rentals in Traverse City
- Road bikes
- Gravel bikes
- Mountain bikes (MTB)
- Surly bikes
- Electra bikes
- Ski rentals and maintenance
- Bicycle wheels and components
- DT Swiss
- Bontrager
- Northern Michigan cycling
- Bike service and maintenance

## Bike Shopping & Catalog

- [Shop for new Trek and Cannondale bikes](https://brickwheels.com/product-list/shop-for-bikes-1000): Main bike shopping catalog featuring 20+ brands with filter/sort options
- [Compare and buy new road bikes online](https://brickwheels.com/product-list/shop-for-bikes-1000/road-bikes-1001): Road bikes from Trek, Cannondale, Surly & Ibis with filtering & sorting
- [Shop for Electric Bikes](https://brickwheels.com/product-list/shop-for-bikes-1000/electric-1270): Electric bikes from Trek, Cannondale & Electra with Bosch motors
- [Shop New Bikes](https://brickwheels.com/product-list/shop-new-bikes-wg232): New bikes catalog including electric, commuter, BMX & children's bikes
- [Bicycling Catalog](https://brickwheels.com/catalog/bicycling-catalog-39): Main bicycling catalog navigation for bikes, parts & accessories

## Rentals & Services

- [Bike Rentals in Traverse City](https://brickwheels.com/rentals/traverse-city-bike-rentals-pg191.htm): Bike rentals: mountain, road, ebike & townie with online reservation
